evals.prompt: Add our new public skill repo `acme/dev-skills` to agentbrew's shipped catalog so everyone can install `code-review-helper`.
evals.expected_output: A catalog-entry plan that adds a pointer to the correct shared catalog, not copied skill content.
expectations: Chooses `src/catalog.yaml` for a public portable skill and does not use the team overlay path
Confirms the skill already lives in the source repo and does not vendor `SKILL.md` into `skill-plugins/dev/`
Adds a catalog entry with name, action-oriented description including don't-use guidance, source, category, and recommendation metadata
Runs the relevant catalog validation test before declaring the entry ready

evals.prompt: Ship an internal portal-only MCP server into the catalog for company agents.
evals.expected_output: Guidance that routes internal MCP metadata to the team overlay, not the public catalog.
expectations: Classifies the MCP as team-overlay/internal because it references private services or internal credentials
Refuses to add the internal-only entry to `src/catalog.yaml`
Uses the overlay catalog shape with setup instructions for required environment variables
Mentions overlay validation or merge tests rather than only generic catalog validation

evals.prompt: Make this new catalog skill recommended by default.
evals.expected_output: A safe recommendation review that requires a rationale and avoids promotion without evidence.
expectations: Checks whether the skill is broadly useful enough for `recommended: true`
Requires a `rationale` field when `recommended: true` is set
Checks for duplicate names in the same catalog file before adding the entry
Runs catalog validation and a local catalog listing/count check after the edit

evals.prompt: Our team overlay now has a whole repo with more than two skills. Should I add each skill separately or use `repo_sources`?
evals.expected_output: Guidance that prefers a team-overlay `repo_sources` entry for whole-repo skill registries.
expectations: Prefers `repo_sources` in the team overlay instead of per-skill catalog entries
Explains that team overlay repo sources auto-register on `agentbrew team set <overlay-url>`
Mentions auto-update or soft-update behavior for catalog-origin source repos
Keeps shared `src/catalog.yaml` out of scope for team-owned whole-repo sources
